verdict.rationale: Ramp documents real-time bidirectional ERP sync, automatic categorization/coding synced directly to accounting systems, and a broad list of accounting integrations (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Xero, Sage Intacct, etc.), plus community corroboration of the platform working well for expense tracking. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of accounting-sync accuracy/reconciliation rather than vendor claims.
